periods.time: vol-11 ch-002 early phase of the final

name.zh: 一辉以技巧压制龙神附身前的史黛菈
name.en: Ikki suppresses Stella before Dragon Spirit

periods.summary: Ikki opens at extreme speed, but Stella disrupts him with Dragon Stomp and launches power attacks. Ikki answers Bolverk by charging through the heat with Saigeki, sees through Mirage, and uses the third secret sword Madoka to return Stella's own force. He then dodges Hell Dragon's Great Jaw, slips around Empress Dress, predicts Stella's habits, repeatedly strikes her, and prevents the apparent preparation for Dragon Spirit.
periods.cause: Ikki must seize tempo before Stella can use her overwhelming awakened dragon power freely.
periods.outcome: Stella appears cornered at close range, but Ikki's instincts warn him that she has prepared a deeper trap.
periods.significance: Demonstrates Ikki's accumulated knowledge of Stella and his ability to temporarily make F-rank technique dominate A-rank power.
